infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Cargo Rush reports your position while you are on a trip, so dispatch can see where the load is.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Cargo Rush keeps reporting your position while the app is in the background, so a trip is tracked with the phone in its cradle and the screen off.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Cargo Rush reports your position while you are on a trip, so dispatch can see where the load is — and pins the pickup or drop-off you are standing in when you ask it to.

plugins.photosPermission: Cargo Rush attaches a photo of the delivered load as proof of delivery.
plugins.cameraPermission: Cargo Rush uses the camera to photograph the load at the door as proof of delivery.
